subject: How can I change this lab ?

messages.author: 3c30c52b0f668f28
messages.subject: How can I change this lab ?
parts:
Hello ggplot2 users,

I would like to change ylab on this plot :
c <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=factor(cyl)))
c + geom_bar() # "count"

This is not working :
c + geom_bar() + ylab("another lab") # not working

How can I do that ?

Thank you very much.

David

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: How can I change this lab ?
parts:
Hi David,

In this case you need to use the full syntax:

+ scale_y_continuous("another lab")

I have an idea about how to fix this problem but it probably won't
make it into this next release (which I'm working on today)

Hadley
